title: androsace centriberica subsp. assoana
intro: Androsace centriberica subsp. assoana, commonly known as Pyrenean androsace, is a plant species within the Primulaceae family. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, digestive disorders, and inflammation. The health benefits of Pyrenean androsace include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain, fever, and infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
